findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: chain_of_title_checklist, placement_readiness_check, judgment_interest_estimate, judgment_state_facts · Private data: document_gap_check, portfolio_snapshot, chain_of_title_checklist, diligence_checklist, asset_class_guide, request_introduction · Public sink: data_tape_header_check, forward_flow_vs_spot, judgment_interest_estimate, judgment_state_facts, buy_box_builder.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: chain_of_title_checklist, placement_readiness_check, judgment_interest_estimate, judgment_state_facts · Private data: document_gap_check, portfolio_snapshot, chain_of_title_checklist, diligence_checklist, asset_class_guide, request_introduction · Public sink: data_tape_header_check, forward_flow_vs_spot, judgment_interest_estimate, judgment_state_facts, buy_box_builder

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
